purpose: Measure paired run-to-run variability with one retained normal binary. A and B are metadata labels only; this is not a candidate comparison or adoption experiment.
claim_scope: Descriptive identical-binary control; do not infer causality, probability, optimization, or adoption.
pairing: Each block and route is one A/B pair; there are twelve pairs per route.
current_head_scope: The current HEAD delta from e3b5acdd is documentation/evidence only for this retained runtime binary.
command_identity: Both labels use the same executable, case, route selector, sample count, warmup count, CPU affinity, and environment. Only the report output path differs; labels are packet metadata.

summary_statistics.p50: child_p50_ns.p50, the median of the twelve child medians per route and label
summary_statistics.p95_p99: nearest-rank quantiles of all 600 raw elapsed samples per route and label
summary_statistics.spread: max minus min of all 600 raw elapsed samples per route and label
summary_statistics.process_metrics: median of twelve child terminal metrics per route and label
summary_statistics.paired_p50_bootstrap: 10000 deterministic resamples of the twelve paired p50 ratios, seed 938; descriptive interval only

terminal_policy: Write the child terminal record before report validation; poll the original process group until terminal; retain failures and never retry, selectively recapture, or replace a child.
source_and_build_policy: Reuse the retained source/build receipts and executable; do not copy source or build a new binary for this diagnostic.
evidence_policy: Keep raw reports, streams, time logs, and packets outside the repository; commit only compact descriptors and summaries below 1 MiB.
